self_locking.basis: lead angle at the Tr8x2 pitch diameter (7.0 mm): atan(2 / (pi x 7.0)) = 5.2 deg. A trapezoidal flank (30 deg) raises the friction angle to atan(mu / cos 15 deg): 5.9 deg at mu 0.10, 8.8 deg at mu 0.15 (steel on brass or acetal, lubricated, typical). Friction angle > lead angle: the screw does not back-drive under a static load. Tr8x8 (17E19S1684MB4): lead angle 20.0 deg, back-drives
self_locking.status: DERIVED from textbook screw mechanics and typical friction coefficients; vibration can still creep a self-locking screw; not tested
